canonical_name: Supplier Risks Not Understood and Managed
description: Risks posed by a supplier or other third party are not understood and managed.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of ongoing risk management activities for suppliers throughout the relationship lifecycle. Check for lack of documentation, prioritization, assessment, response, or monitoring of supplier-related risks.
